info.title: shotdetect
info.description: shotdetect: shot/cut detection from the command line, with the same results as PySceneDetect's scenedetect (list-scenes, stats, save-images, split-video). Needs ffmpeg.

options.name: --input
options.description: Video file, a URL (http, rtsp, ...), or - for standard input

options.name: --detector
options.description:
adaptive, content, threshold, hist or hash (default: adaptive). Repeat
to combine detectors, as scenedetect does: -t, -m and --filter-mode
after a -d apply to that detector (-d content -t 30 -d threshold -t 8)

options.name: --filter-mode
options.description: content: how min-scene-len is enforced (default merge)

options.name: --drop-short-scenes
options.description: Detect without min-scene-len, then drop shots shorter than it

options.name: --merge-last-scene
options.description: Merge the last shot into the previous one if shorter than min-scene-len

options.name: --downscale
options.description: Downscale frames by n (scenedetect -d); default automatic, 1 = none

options.name: --threshold
options.description:
content: content_val threshold (default 27)
adaptive: adaptive ratio threshold (default 3)
threshold: mean pixel level of a fade (default 12)
hist: drop in histogram correlation (default 0.05)
hash: fraction of hash bits that differ (default 0.395)

options.name: --min-scene-len
options.description: Minimum shot length: frames (15), seconds (0.6s, 0.6) or HH:MM:SS.mmm (default 0.6s)

options.name: --min-content-val
options.description: adaptive: minimum content_val for a cut (default 15)

options.name: --frame-window
options.description: adaptive: frames on each side to average (default 2)

options.name: --weights
options.description:
content/adaptive: weights of hue, saturation, luma and edge
differences in content_val (default 1 1 1 0)

options.name: --kernel-size
options.description:
content/adaptive: odd size >= 3 to widen edges by
(default: from the resolution)

options.name: --luma-only
options.description: Only use the V (brightness) channel (overrides --weights)

options.name: --bins
options.description: hist: number of luma histogram bins (default 256)

options.name: --hash-size
options.description: hash: hash is n x n bits (default 16)

options.name: --hash-lowpass
options.description: hash: shrink frames to size*n pixels per side first (default 2)

options.name: --fade-bias
options.description: threshold: cut position between fade-out (-1) and fade-in (+1)

options.name: --compat
options.description: Which PySceneDetect release to reproduce (default and only: 0.7.1)

options.name: --frame-rate
options.description:
Override the detected frame rate (scenedetect -f); also the
rate of an image sequence such as frames/%04d.png (default 25)

options.name: --ffmpeg-dir
options.description: Folder containing ffmpeg and ffprobe (default: found on PATH)

options.name: --decoder
--start
options.description: Start here: HH:MM:SS[.mmm], seconds (12.5s) or 1-based frame (300)

options.name: --end
options.description: Stop here (exclusive); same formats, frames 0-based

options.name: --duration
options.description: Analyse this much from the start (not with --end)

options.name: --frame-skip
options.description: Analyse every (n+1)th frame (not with --stats)

options.name: --deinterlace
options.description:
Deinterlace (ffmpeg's yadif) before analysis: on (no value),
or auto: when the stream is flagged interlaced

options.name: --crop
options.description: Only analyse this part of the frame (inclusive pixel corners)

options.name: --threads
options.description:
ffmpeg decoder threads (0 = ffmpeg's choice; default: CPUs - 1, at most 4,
or 8 on the yuv420p fast path). ~20 MB each at 1080p

options.name: --ffmpeg-resize
options.description:
Downscale with ffmpeg bilinear instead of an exact port of
cv2.resize (faster, but cuts can differ from PySceneDetect)

options.name: --csv
options.description: Write shot list as CSV

options.name: --skip-cuts
options.description: Leave the "Timecode List:" row out of the CSV (list-scenes -s)

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Don't print the shot list (list-scenes -q)

options.name: --json
options.description: Write shot list as JSON

options.name: --stats
options.description: Write per-frame metrics as CSV (like scenedetect -s)

options.name: --save-images
options.description: Save JPEG thumbnails per shot (like scenedetect save-images)

options.name: --num-images
options.description: Thumbnails per shot (default 3)

options.name: --frame-margin
options.description: Frames to keep away from each end of a shot (default 1)

options.name: --save-html
options.description:
Write the shot list as an HTML page with thumbnails (scenedetect
save-html); images go to --save-images <dir>, or next to the page

options.name: --html-no-images
options.description: Leave the thumbnails out of the HTML page

options.name: --html-image-height
options.description: Size attributes of the HTML thumbnails

options.name: --save-edl
options.description: CMX 3600 EDL (scenedetect save-edl); --edl-title <t>, --edl-reel <r>,

options.name: --save-fcp
options.description: Final Cut Pro XML (save-fcp); --fcp-format <fcpx|fcp7> (default fcpx)

options.name: --save-otio
options.description: OpenTimelineIO timeline (save-otio); --otio-name <n>, --otio-no-audio

options.name: --save-qp
options.description: x264 QP file with a keyframe at each cut (save-qp); --qp-disable-shift

options.name: --split-video
options.description: Cut the video into one mp4 per shot (like scenedetect split-video)

options.name: --image-filename
options.description: save-images name, no extension (default $VIDEO_NAME-Scene-$SCENE_NUMBER-$IMAGE_NUMBER)

options.name: --split-filename
options.description: split-video name (default $VIDEO_NAME-Scene-$SCENE_NUMBER)

options.name: --output
options.description: Folder for outputs given as relative paths; $VIDEO_NAME works in every output path

options.name: --config
options.description:
scenedetect's config file (scenedetect.cfg): its values are the defaults; keys
ShotDetector doesn't have are listed on stderr

options.name: --load-scenes
options.description: Take the shots from a scene list CSV instead of detecting (scenedetect load-scenes)

options.name: --load-scenes-column
options.description: Its column with each shot's start (default "Start Frame")

options.name: --split-copy
options.description: Copy streams instead of re-encoding (fast; cuts on keyframes)

options.name: --split-high-quality
options.description: CRF 17, preset slow (instead of 22, veryfast)

options.name: --split-expand
options.description: Stretch the first/last clip to the video's start/end (with -s/-e)
